intro.title: CSS Modules
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Angular component that uses CSS Modules to style its elements. You will learn how CSS Modules work by scoping styles locally to a component, preventing conflicts with other parts of your application. The main technologies involved are Angular components, TypeScript, and CSS Modules with file naming conventions like .component.css. This approach helps you write maintainable and modular CSS in your Angular projects.
intro.usecase: CSS Modules are essential in large-scale Angular applications where component styling must be isolated and predictable. You'll use them when building reusable UI libraries, dashboard widgets, or complex forms where each component's styles shouldn't interfere with others. For example, a financial dashboard with multiple independent chart components, or an e-commerce product filter panel where each filter needs distinct styling without global CSS conflicts. This pattern ensures your styles remain scoped to their components, making maintenance and team collaboration much easier in real production environments.
